docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
Krishnaswami Aiyangar’s Calcutta lectures on the south’s share in Indian culture: the Tamil Sangam, the Āḻvārs and Nāyaṇmārs, the Pallavas and Colas and their temples (Calcutta, 1923). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the Robarts Library, University of Toronto; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: Some contributions of South India to Indian culture · Krishnaswami Aiyangar, Sakkottai, 1871-1947 · 1923, 480 scanned pages. Published 1923; Sakkottai Krishnaswami Aiyangar died 1947; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
